purpose: Determine whether a cross-stage linear hard-field conservation witness adds material detection over the strongest conventional context/local-guard baseline on real Frank v0.1 lifecycle episodes.
frozen_units: exact artifact and runtime dependency identities
exact selected state lineage and semantic epochs

methods.description: M0 plus one immutable conventional CurrentExecutionContext carrying the exact same material hard fields, without linear consume/reissue.

M1-equivalent fields plus stage transform mask/residual and single-use parent->successor witness lineage. Existing stage-specific semantic validators remain authoritative for language/compiler meaning.
Exact-byte ancestry baseline wherever possible; expected to be strong on identity but over-strict on permitted semantic-preserving transformations.

valid_controls: declared semantic-preserving backend rebuild with independent source/target differential PASS
declared schema migration whose independent validator and transform mask both PASS
legitimate restart of the selected lineage with current lease/recovery evidence
semantic_validator_rule: Compiler/language meaning is never inferred from LSCW hard fields alone. Source-vs-target behavior/refinement/differential/metamorphic/verified-compiler evidence is a separate required stage validator and its identity/result becomes an input dimension.
primary_metrics: unsafe mutation rejection rate by class
acceptance: M2 uniquely rejects at least one material real cross-stage mutation that M1 accepts
M2 accepts all declared valid controls accepted by correct current semantics
compiler-semantic mutants are rejected only with independent stage validator evidence, proving no circular semantic-root claim
resource/state amplification remains within a declared budget and no simpler equivalent encoding dominates
crash/restart does not permit consumed-parent replay or sibling lineage advance
kill: M1 matches all M2 decisions on real target episodes with lower complexity/resource cost
M2 causes material false rejects on legitimate transformation/recovery
linear witness persistence creates a new recovery/availability failure larger than the threat removed
current existing lineage/generation/consume-bound mechanisms already prove the same property without a new cross-stage primitive
rollback: Shadow-only experiment artifacts can be deleted without changing target behavior. Any later production candidate must remain separately reversible and last-known-good protected.
